description: Improve PDF and DOCX parsers to handle real-world documents that currently cause 422 errors. PDF parser needs hex strings, nested parens, octal escapes, Unicode, more text operators. DOCX parser needs data descriptor support, paragraph breaks, fallback paths. Both need a raw text extraction fallback.
steps: Rewrite PDF parser to handle: hex strings (<AABB>), nested parentheses, octal escapes, UTF-16BE Unicode, CIDFont hex codes, more text operators (Td, TD, T*, ', "), kerning in TJ arrays
Rewrite DOCX parser to handle: data descriptors (bit 3 flag), central directory fallback, paragraph breaks, line breaks, xml:space=preserve, fallback document paths
Add raw text extraction fallback for both PDF and DOCX when structured parsing returns empty
acceptance_criteria: PDF parser extracts text from hex strings like <48656C6C6F>
PDF parser handles nested parentheses in strings
PDF parser handles octal escape sequences like \101
PDF parser handles UTF-16BE encoded hex strings (FEFF BOM)
DOCX parser handles ZIP data descriptors (bit 3 flag)
Raw text fallback extracts visible ASCII when structured parsing fails
All existing tests in server/tests/parseFile.test.js pass
Parser returns meaningful text for typical resume PDFs
